address: 14 Yolo Forest Community, Soi Somkid, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok, 10330, Thailand
bio: The interior, decorated in elegant dark tones with wood-clad walls, creates a nostalgic ambiance. The menu offers a modern take on Ratchaburi cuisine, where the intense flavours and aromas of each dish pair well with Thai herbs. The duck confit with red curry and the stir-fried minced chicken thigh with Thai herbs and five peppercorns are recommended....
